## Clip Engine 0.7.1

Your Discord status now shows what you're playing.

- **Discord status.** While Discord is open, your profile shows the game you're in, how long you've been playing, your kills, deaths and assists in the match and how many clips you've saved. It says when a long recording is running or when you've tabbed out, and it clears when the game closes. Turn it off in Settings > **Discord status**.

Everything from 0.7.0 is included.

## Install

1. Download `Clip_Engine-…-windows-x64.zip` below and unzip it anywhere.
2. Run `ClipEngine.exe`. It starts `clip_engine.exe` (the recorder) in the background, with no console window.

Needs Windows 10 version 1903 or newer (Windows 11 recommended) and a GPU with a hardware video encoder. Windows may warn that the app is from an unknown publisher because it isn't code-signed yet; choose **More info → Run anyway**.
